args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'.
- Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti and Bettina Kroll

Bettina, one correction to my reply: the draft is in my mailbox (assistant@pemberline.com), not in yours or Sofia's, so someone will need to open it there and forward or re-send it to June. I've also not sent anything.
